ns2:section.sectionText: This course will bring together faculty from Urban Planning, Anthropology, Engineering, and Community Health for an interdisciplinary examination of international sustainable development. The focus will be on a specific case: a proposed irrigation project in the highlands community of Lumbisi, Ecuador. Participants will have the opportunity to travel to Ecuador during Summer Term I. Please see the instructor for more information about the course and about possible (optional) summer research experiences connected with this course.
